audit: Every target test year chooses Elo parameters only from seasons before that year
Calibration seasons are before the tested season and disjoint from tuning
Games on the same calendar day are forecast simultaneously, then results are applied
The closing line is known only as a historical price reference, not a true pregame entry fill
No CLV can be calculated from a single closing price
Strategies are retrospectively assessed and are not independent prospective investment results
Selections and thresholds are not optimized based on test-season returns
Tie games excluded from graded hypothetical bets; count disclosed
Accuracy measures all games, not just filtered candidate picks
researchWarnings: This 2025 historical data and existing BETQ model variants have been repeatedly inspected; these are exploratory reconstructions, not a pristine untouched model trial.
Historical closing odds from nflverse are source-retrospective, not pregame timestamped bet fills.
The rule uses those closing odds as a hypothetical decision-time price and cannot establish achievable ROI or CLV.
Current feature challenger is not yet refitted separately for each prior test season; this artifact evaluates the season-fitted Elo baseline only.
